crossRefs.note: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.
You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

parallels.note: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy…

translations.web: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.
translations.bsb: Set the mercy seat atop the ark and put the Testimony that I will give you into the ark.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give
translations.asv: And thou shalt put the mercy-seat above upon the ark; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee.
